svg.title: Flows wireframe
svg.text: Transfers, debt payments, and leftover income.
A transfer moves money. Net worth is unchanged by the transfer itself.
Anything left after expenses, debt, and savings flows
Mandatory payment $1,702 could not be met in
Each flow stores source, destination, amount, and frequency. Frequency supports monthly, yearly, and one-off dates.
A $500 monthly transfer lowers savings and raises taxable by $500; net worth does not move.
The preview is a backend result for the selected month, so the UI never computes balances itself.
A mandatory payment that cannot be met becomes an explicit shortfall with a warning, never a silent negative
